pkgmetadata.longdescription:
OmniDiff is a content-aware diff tool. Instead of aligning two files line by line, it parses code with tree-sitter and matches the two syntax trees, so a change is reported as what it structurally is - an insertion, a deletion, an update, or a move - rather than as whichever lines happened to line up. Pictures, archives, fonts, cursors, message catalogs and PDFs are diffed by what they hold: pixels, files, glyphs, frames, messages and pages.
It runs as an interactive terminal UI, as a plain-text batch formatter, or as a JSON emitter for editor integrations, and it works as a git difftool backend and a Jujutsu (jj) diff formatter.
